input.query: update user PATCH users controller service

candidates.explanation: The spread order is reversed: `{ ...payload, ...UserMapper.toDomain(entity) }`. The existing entity values are spread last and overwrite the incoming payload (firstName, lastName, role, etc.). The save call therefore writes the old values back. The request returns 200 with the unchanged user and the database doesn't change. The document repository does it correctly, with the payload spread last.

fix.description: Spread the existing entity first and the payload last, so the payload overrides the stored values: UserMapper.toPersistence({ ...UserMapper.toDomain(entity), ...payload })
